definition.title: Healthy-adult resting supine pulmonary capillary reference candidate

validity.population: healthy adults represented by two small historical human cohorts
validity.physiological_state: resting and recumbent, coupled to the nominal six-litre-per-minute M3 pulmonary reference flow
validity.description: Equivalent parallel-tube closure of functional pulmonary capillary blood volume, morphometric lumen capacity, and resting flow. It is a research reference candidate, not an anatomical reconstruction or patient model.

sources.citation: Lewis BM, Lin TH, Noe FE, Komisaruk R. The measurement of pulmonary capillary blood volume and pulmonary membrane diffusing capacity in normal subjects; the effects of exercise and position. J Clin Invest. 1958;37(7):1061-1070. doi:10.1172/JCI103687.

sources.role: human morphometric capillary volume, surface, equivalent radius, and non-identifiability of total capillary length

sources.citation: MEHLISSA healthy-adult resting supine pulmonary 0D reference candidate, version 1.0.0.
sources.role: nominal resting pulmonary flow and compatible reference-state definition

sources.role: MEHLISSA capillary-layer intent, serial regions, parallel perfusion, and continuity requirement

limitations: The capillary region is an equivalent parallel-tube closure, not a reconstruction of the alveolar sheet network.
Equivalent path counts are numerical closure variables and must not be interpreted as anatomical vessel counts.
The four-person recumbent functional-volume result is small and historical; its method depends on carbon-monoxide diffusing-capacity assumptions and pulmonary capillary hematocrit.
The morphometric cohort contains five post-mortem lungs and describes lumen capacity rather than the blood volume perfused at rest.
The representative capillary path length is derived after fixing a round numerical perfused-path count; human total capillary length is not treated as identifiable.
Arteriolar and venular transition regions are five-millilitre numerical boundary surrogates, not physiologically qualified compartment volumes.
The nominal flow is inherited from the M3 reference card and was not measured in the same subjects as either capillary data set.
Recruitment, gravity, lobar heterogeneity, ventilation-perfusion coupling, hematocrit dynamics, pulsatility, exercise, disease, age, sex, and patient specificity remain outside this card.

reference_flow.derivation: The six L/min nominal resting flow is reused unchanged from the M3 healthy-adult supine pulmonary reference; it is not a jointly measured value from the capillary cohorts.

functional_blood_volume.derivation: Published mean Vc of 85.9 mL for four normal subjects measured recumbent. The sample SD is recomputed from the four reported values 87.1, 101.2, 66.4, and 88.8 mL; the published rounded mean remains the executable anchor.

morphometric_lumen_volume.derivation: Mean whole-lung alveolar capillary lumen volume and SD from five human lungs. It constrains total equivalent capacity, not resting perfused blood volume.

morphometric_surface_area.derivation: Mean whole-lung alveolar capillary endothelial surface area and SD from the same five human lungs; retained as evidence even though the current transit runtime does not consume surface area.

equivalent_diameter.derivation: Twice the reported model-based mean equivalent radius 3.15 micrometres; twice its reported SD 0.61 micrometres. It is a cylindrical-equivalent diameter, not a claim that the alveolar sheet is tubular.

representative_path_length.derivation: After selecting four billion equivalent perfused paths, length equals 85.9 mL divided by path count and the area of a 6.30-micrometre equivalent tube. The count is deliberately round and non-anatomical; length is therefore not independent evidence.

reference_transit_time.derivation: Functional capillary blood volume divided by nominal pulmonary flow: 85.9 mL / 100 mL/s = 0.859 s. This is a volume-residence closure, not a direct transit measurement.

volume_each.derivation: Five mL is assigned to each serial transition so the current three-region software contract remains executable without presenting unqualified arteriole or venule volumes as physiological evidence. Each transition contributes 0.05 s at the reference flow.
